advancedSettings.processFilesDescription: Handle attachments by reading file content on demand instead of including all attachment content in the initial prompt.
advancedSettings.addAttachmentDescription: Enables the orchestrator’s built-in tool for attaching a file to the final response. When enabled, the agent can add a file it produced (e.g. one created via the file tools) to the response’s attachments. When disabled, no attachment tool is exposed to the orchestrator.
advancedSettings.webFetchDescription: Enables the orchestrator’s built-in tool for fetching an external web resource for this app. When enabled, the agent can fetch an external URL and get its content back inline, or saved to the app’s workspace for larger content. When disabled, no fetch tool is exposed to the orchestrator.

advancedSettings.timeAwarenessDescription: Gives the agent the current date and time, helping it understand references like "today," deadlines, and schedules.
advancedSettings.builtInFileToolsDescription: Lets the agent browse, search, read, and edit files within the app’s file context. Includes write access, so worth reviewing for agents handling sensitive files.
